summary: More platform gateway settings: Request timeout (proxy returns 504), Manage organization auth (MANAGE_ORGANIZATION_AUTH moves to the gateway on upgrade from 2.4 but isn't synced with controller, so keep both consistent), Stream idle timeout and Max stream duration for Lightspeed chatbot streams, and Aap deployment type.
questions: Why does the AAP gateway return 504?
Where is MANAGE_ORGANIZATION_AUTH set in AAP 2.6?
